systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale et de la Promotion Civique; statistical production said to depend heavily on partners' financing
systems.tiers: Functions and publishes a statistical yearbook each year; weakly decentralised; the compact proposes revising the collection tools, speeding decentralisation and generalising digitalisation of the collection and dissemination of school statistics

systems.country_label: outil informatisé de gestion des enseignants; base intégrée des Ressources Humaines
systems.tiers: Proposed, not in place: teacher allocation and an HR base with a unique identifier per teacher to reconcile payroll, the HR base and the SIGE

systems.system: système d'interconnexion des bases de données du Ministère
systems.country_label: système d'interconnexion des bases des données du Ministère
systems.tiers: Proposed, not in place: school census, human-resources and budget databases to be interconnected within the MENPC, between the education ministries and with the Fonction Publique, Finances and INSEED; a single code per school

systems.country_label: plateforme de formation à distance des enseignants; IFADEM; imaginecole
